title: Synthesis, Biological Evaluation, and Molecular Docking Study of 3-Amino and 3-Hydroxy-seco A Derivatives of alpha-Amyrin and 3-Epilupeol as Inhibitors of COX-2 Activity and NF-kB Activation.
authors: Romero-Estrada, Antonio; Boto, Alicia; Gonzalez-Christen, Judith; Romero-Estudillo, Ivan; Garduno-Ramirez, Maria Luisa; Razo-Hernandez, Rodrigo Said; Marquina, Silvia; Maldonado-Magana, Amalia; Columba-Palomares, Maria C; Sanchez-Carranza, Jessica Nayelli; Alvarez, Laura
one_liner_zh: 该研究合成并评估三萜衍生物对COX-2和NF-kB的抑制活性，分子对接仅针对COX-2蛋白，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: In this study, a series of novel 3-seco-A derivatives of the natural triterpenes alpha-amyrin (1) and 3-epilupeol (2) were synthesized by a one-pot radical scission-oxidation procedure and evaluated in vitro and in vivo for their capacity to inhibit the inflammatory process. For the in vitro studies, the trans-4-hydroxy-l-proline methyl ester derivatives (1f and 2f) were consistently effective in inhibiting NO, IL-6, and TNF-alpha secretion, as well as inhibition of NF-kappaB activation, in RAW cells stimulated by LPS. The further in vivo anti-inflammatory study revealed that the trans-4-hydroxy-l-proline methyl ester derivatives (1f and 2f), together with 1g, were the most effective in inhibiting TPA-induced edema. Interestingly, the alpha-amyrin derivatives were the most potent inhibitors of COX-2, but inhibited COX-1 only to some extent. The hydroxyl derivative (1c) was selective for COX-2 inhibition (66.3 +/- 1.1% at 17.5 muM) without affecting the COX-1 isoform and did not present toxicity. Molecular docking studies revealed that these compounds bind with their polar region in the cavity over Arg-120, and their lipophilic part is orientated to the HEM cofactor similarly to the natural substrate arachidonic acid in the catalytic site of COX-2. These results indicated that seco-A ursane derivatives could be considered promising candidates for the future development of selective NF-kappaB and COX-2 inhibitors.
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，通过一锅自由基断裂-氧化程序合成了一系列新型的天然三萜类化合物α-香树脂醇（1）和3-表羽扇豆醇（2）的3-seco-A衍生物，并在体外和体内评估了它们抑制炎症过程的能力。在体外研究中，反式-4-羟基-L-脯氨酸甲酯衍生物（1f和2f）在LPS刺激的RAW细胞中持续有效地抑制NO、IL-6和TNF-α的分泌，以及抑制NF-κB的激活。进一步的体内抗炎研究表明，反式-4-羟基-L-脯氨酸甲酯衍生物（1f和2f）以及1g在抑制TPA诱导的水肿方面最为有效。有趣的是，α-香树脂醇衍生物是COX-2最有效的抑制剂，但对COX-1仅有一定程度的抑制。羟基衍生物（1c）对COX-2抑制具有选择性（在17.5 μM时抑制率为66.3 ± 1.1%），而不影响COX-1亚型，且未表现出毒性。分子对接研究表明，这些化合物通过其极性区域结合在Arg-120上方的空腔中，其亲脂部分定向于HEM辅因子，类似于天然底物花生四烯酸在COX-2催化位点的结合方式。这些结果表明，seco-A乌苏烷衍生物可被视为未来开发选择性NF-κB和COX-2抑制剂的潜在候选化合物。
